row:
Sharing videos from Healing Hands Equine Mobile Veterinary Service which focuses on "Treating the Whole Horse" with integrative medicine, chiropractic, acupuncture and dentistry.

Healing Hands Equine is based out of the San Tan Valley area of Arizona and provides holistic care to the greater Phoenix area as well as monthly visits to Southeastern Arizona.
